item.title: Pleasanton City Manager Beaudin receives 3.5% pay raise
item.description: The Pleasanton City Council unanimously approved a number of labor contract agreements during its consent calendar portion of the Dec. 16 meeting, which included 3.5% raises for both the city manager and city attorney as well as separate salary increases for city management, confidential employee groups and unionized city employees.
